description_en: Intelligent Speech Interaction is a human-machine interaction technology that enables users to hold natural, voice-based conversations with machines
description_zh: 智能语音交互服务，是一种人机交互技术，它允许用户通过语音与机器进行自然的对话和沟通
name: SmartCall

parameters.help_en:
Displayed number for the called party. This must be a number you have purchased.

Log on to the Voice Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home). Go to Voice Numbers > Real Number Management to view your purchased numbers
parameters.help_zh:
被叫显号。必须是已购买的号码。

您可以登录语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home)，在语音号码>真实号管理页面查看已购买的号码
parameters.name: called_show_number

parameters.help_en: Called number. Only numbers from the Chinese mainland are supported
parameters.help_zh: 被叫号码。仅支持中国内地号码
parameters.name: called_number

parameters.help_en:
Voice file for smart outbound calls.

If the voice file is uploaded to the console, set VoiceCode to the voice ID of the file. Log on to the Voice Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home). Go to Voice File Management > Intelligent Speech Interaction Voice Files. Click Details to view the voice ID
parameters.help_zh:
智能外呼放音文件。

当放音文件为控制台上传的语音文件时：参数VoiceCode指定为文件的语音ID。您可以登录语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home)，选择语音文件管理>智能语音交互放音文件，单击详情查看对应的语音ID
parameters.name: voice_code

parameters.help_en:
Whether to record the call. Valid values:

true: Record the call.

false: Do not record the call
parameters.help_zh:
通话过程中是否录音。取值：

true：录音。
false：不录音
parameters.name: record_flag

parameters.help_en: Volume for playing audio. Valid values: -4 to 4. We recommend setting this to 1
parameters.help_zh: 播放用户音频的音量。取值范围：-4~4，建议设置为1
parameters.name: volume

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 参数暂不支持使用
parameters.name: speed

parameters.help_en:
The Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model. The valid values are:

customer_service_8k (default): Mandarin.

dialect_customer_service_8k: Mandarin with a strong accent.

When you call the SmartCall operation, you can specify the ASR model by setting either the AsrModelId or AsrBaseId parameter.

If you set only the AsrModelId parameter, the system uses the specified ASR model.

If you set only the AsrBaseId parameter, the system uses the specified ASR foundation model.

If you do not set either parameter, the system uses the default ASR foundation model. The AsrBaseId parameter defaults to customer_service_8k, which is the Mandarin ASR foundation model.

If you set both parameters, confirm that they are compatible
parameters.help_zh:
ASR模型。取值：

customer_service_8k（默认）：普通话。
dialect_customer_service_8k：重口音。

调用SmartCall接口时需要指定使用的ASR模型，建议参数AsrModelId和AsrBaseId二者选填其一。
如果仅设置AsrModelId，表示使用指定的ASR模型。
如果仅设置AsrBaseId，表示使用指定的ASR基础模型。
如果二者均未设置，则使用默认的ASR基础模型，即参数AsrBaseId默认为customer_service_8k，表示使用ASR普通话基础模型。
如果二者同时设置，请确认二者是正确对应的
parameters.name: asr_model_id

parameters.help_en:
Pause duration. Sets how long a user must pause before the system treats it as the end of a sentence. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 300 to 1200.

If the value is outside this range, the default value 800 is used.

This parameter takes effect only the first time it is set
parameters.help_zh:
停顿时长。用于设置用户停顿多久表示一句话结束。单位：毫秒，取值范围：300~1200。

如果指定值不在参数范围中，则该参数默认取值为800。
该参数首次设置有效，后续设置无效
parameters.name: pause_time

parameters.help_en:
Mute duration. Sets how long a user must remain silent before the call ends. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 1000 to 20000.

If the value is outside this range, the default value 10000 is used.

You can set this parameter dynamically during the call. The last setting takes effect
parameters.help_zh:
静音时长。用于设置用户多久不说话通话结束。单位：毫秒，取值范围：1000~20000。

如果指定值不在参数范围中，则该参数默认取值为10000。
通话过程中可动态设置，以最后一次设置为准
parameters.name: mute_time

parameters.help_en:
Whether the current media file can be interrupted. Default value: true.

If this is false, the current playback cannot be interrupted—even if the next action (action_break) is true.

action_code_break has higher priority than action_break
parameters.help_zh:
当前返回的媒体文件是否可以被打断。默认取值为true，即可被打断。

如果为false，即使下一个动作action_break为true，也无法打断当前放音。

action_code_break优先级高于action_break
parameters.name: action_code_break

parameters.help_en:
ID reserved for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller in the callback message.

String. Length: 1 to 15 bytes
parameters.help_zh:
预留给调用方使用的ID。 最终会通过在回执消息中将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度为1~15个字节
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en: Dynamic extension ID reserved for the caller. Returned in the callback URL for developer identification
parameters.help_zh: 预留给调用方使用的动态扩展ID。在回调地址中带回，用于客户的开发标识
parameters.name: dynamic_id

parameters.help_en:
Early media speech recognition flag. Valid values:

false (default): Disabled.

true: Enabled.

Set this to true to record why the call was not answered
parameters.help_zh:
早媒体语音识别标识。取值：

false（默认）：关闭。
true：开启。

设为true会记录通话未接听的原因
parameters.name: early_media_asr

parameters.help_en: TTS parameter string in JSON format. Must match the TTS parameters in VoiceCode
parameters.help_zh: TTS参数传递字符串，格式为JSON。必须与VoiceCode的TTS参数对应
parameters.name: voice_code_param

parameters.help_en:
Maximum call duration. The call ends automatically after this time. Unit: seconds.

Maximum duration is 3600 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
最大通话时长，超时后自动挂断。单位：秒。

通话时长最长3600秒
parameters.name: session_timeout

parameters.help_en:
Interrupt based on continuous speech duration. Unit: milliseconds.

If ActionCodeBreak is true, continuous speech interrupts the current playback. If this parameter is not set or is 0, it does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
基于用户持续说话时长打断。单位：毫秒。

如果当前媒体文件ActionCodeBreak为true，用户持续说话可以打断当前播放。不设置或者为0，不生效
parameters.name: action_code_time_break

parameters.help_en: Voice style for TTS variables. Default value: xiaoyun. For a full list, see Voice Styles
parameters.help_zh: TTS变量播放时的声音风格。默认为xiaoyun。具体风格，请参见下表声音风格列表
parameters.name: tts_style

parameters.help_en: Volume for playing TTS variables. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: TTS变量播放的音量。取值范围：0~100，默认值为0
parameters.name: tts_volume

parameters.help_en: Speech speed for TTS variables. Valid values: -200 to 200. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: TTS变量播放时的声音速度。取值范围：-200~200，默认值为0
parameters.name: tts_speed

parameters.help_en:
Whether to configure TTS voice settings. Valid values:

true: Configure. Use TtsStyle, TtsVolume, and TtsSpeed to set voice style.

false: Do not configure. Other TTS parameters are ignored even if set
parameters.help_zh:
是否设置TTS声音参数。取值：

true：设置。需要通过TtsStyle、TtsVolume、TtsSpeed三个参数来设置声音风格。
false：不设置。不需要设置相关参数，即便设置了也不生效
parameters.name: tts_conf

parameters.help_en:
ASR foundation model. Valid values:

customer_service_8k (default): Mandarin.

dialect_customer_service_8k: Heavy accent.

When you call the SmartCall API, specify an ASR model. Set either AsrModelId or AsrBaseId, but not both.

If you set only AsrModelId, the specified ASR model is used.

If you set only AsrBaseId, the specified ASR foundation model is used.

If you set neither, the default ASR foundation model is used. The default value of AsrBaseId is customer_service_8k, which means the Mandarin ASR foundation model is used.

If you set both, make sure they match correctly
parameters.help_zh:
ASR基础模型。取值：

customer_service_8k（默认）：普通话。
dialect_customer_service_8k：重口音。

调用SmartCall接口时需要指定使用的ASR模型，建议参数AsrModelId和AsrBaseId二者选填其一。
如果仅设置AsrModelId，表示使用指定的ASR模型。
如果仅设置AsrBaseId，表示使用指定的ASR基础模型。
如果二者均未设置，则使用默认的ASR基础模型，即参数AsrBaseId默认为customer_service_8k，表示使用ASR普通话基础模型。
如果二者同时设置，请确认二者是正确对应的
parameters.name: asr_base_id

parameters.help_en:
Streaming ASR. Uses the first few spoken words to infer meaning. Valid values:

0: Disabled.

1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
流式ASR，根据用户说的前几个字智能判断语义。取值：

0：关闭。
1：开启
parameters.name: stream_asr

parameters.help_en:
Background voice file ID played during user-robot conversations.

Log on to the Voice Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home). Go to Voice File Management > Intelligent Speech Interaction Voice Files. Click Details to view the voice ID
parameters.help_zh:
用户和机器人对话时播放的背景语音文件ID。

您可以登录语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/overview/home)，选择语音文件管理>智能语音交互放音文件，单击详情按钮，查看对应的语音ID
parameters.name: background_file_code

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 参数暂不支持使用
parameters.name: background_volume

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 参数暂不支持使用
parameters.name: background_speed

parameters.help_en:
Whether to apply inverse text normalization (ITN) during post-processing. Default value: false.

If set to true, Chinese numerals convert to Arabic numerals in output
parameters.help_zh:
是否在后处理中执行ITN。默认为false，即不执行。

设置为true时，中文数字将转为阿拉伯数字输出
parameters.name: enable_itn

parameters.help_en: The NoiseThreshold
parameters.help_zh: The NoiseThreshold
parameters.name: noise_threshold

Unique receipt ID for this call.

Use the [QueryCallDetailByCallId](~~QueryCallDetailByCallId~~) API to query call details by CallId
CallId.description_zh:
此次通话的唯一回执ID。

CallId可以通过[QueryCallDetailByCallId](~~QueryCallDetailByCallId~~)接口查询呼叫详情

Request status code.

OK means the request succeeded.

For other error codes, see [API Error Codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
